clues.text: God warned Pharaoh these would come into his palace, onto his bed, and into ovens and kneading bowls.
When Aaron stretched out his hand over the waters of Egypt, these came up and covered the land.
Pharaoh's magicians used their magic arts to bring even more of these up onto the land of Egypt.
When Moses asked Pharaoh when he should pray for these to be taken away, Pharaoh answered, "Tomorrow."
After these died in Egypt's houses, courtyards and fields, they were piled in heaps and the land stank.
A psalm recalling God's wonders in Egypt says He sent devouring flies, and these that devastated the people.
John saw three unclean spirits that looked like these coming from the mouths of the dragon, beast and false prophet.
